The question card and desk-plan's plan card now stay in the terminal after `/clear` or `/resume`, even with Remote Control on at startup.

- `/clear` and `/resume` inside a window empty desk-look's record of where you last typed. If nothing was typed after that (a plugin such as a handoff skill that runs `/clear` and then a command), the cards fell back to the session file, and with `remoteControlAtStartup` every session looks bridged there, so ExitPlanMode and AskUserQuestion opened Claude Code's full-screen dialog. desk-look now keeps the last place you typed for the same process and puts it back after the switch
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-grant move to 0.72.3 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
